metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where my aim was on vacation but Valorant said ‘Hold my mouse’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t even aiming properly!
Enemies just gifted me a double tap.
Click if your best kills come with zero effort but maximum chaos!
Valorant logic is wild, and I’m here for it.

Tap if your aim ghosts you but kills still drop!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
